title: A staffer joins a Local Chapter meeting
body: Twenty minutes on how a health bill actually moves, or how a legislative office works. Students submit their questions in advance, so the time is spent answering rather than warming up.

title: Host a delegation of members
body: A tour and a short sit-down with your health legislative aide. Students arrive with a written agenda and leave a one-page summary of what they heard.

title: Speak at our Midwinter Leadership Conference
body: In front of District students who have already chosen health careers, at the point in the year when they are deciding how far to push themselves.

title: Judge at the State Leadership Conference
body: Judges score students in clinical and leadership events against published rubrics. Training is provided, and no clinical background is required for leadership events.

title: A letter of greeting or recognition
body: Read aloud at the State Leadership Conference and printed in the programme, where every competing student and advisor sees it. We would also welcome your support for a DC HOSA Week proclamation.
